places.ai_summary: A scenic boat cruise on Lake Thun, offering stunning views of the surrounding mountains and villages.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for seasonal variations.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance during peak season.

places.name: Lake Brienz Boat Cruise
places.ai_summary: A picturesque boat cruise on Lake Brienz, known for its emerald-green waters and stunning mountain backdrop.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for seasonal variations.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Giessbach Falls.

places.name: Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe (excursion)
places.ai_summary: A popular excursion to the Jungfraujoch, the highest railway station in Europe, offering stunning alpine views.
places.place_tip: Dress warmly, even in summer.

places.name: Schynige Platte Railway & Panorama
places.ai_summary: A cogwheel train journey to Schynige Platte, offering breathtaking views of the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau mountains.

opening_hours.notes: Seasonal operation, check timetable in advance.

places.place_tip: Combine with a hike for a full-day adventure.

places.name: St. Beatus Caves
places.ai_summary: A fascinating cave system near Interlaken, with impressive stalactites, stalagmites, and an underground lake.
places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and a jacket.
